nodes.text: Retrieving polymorphs for multiple nitride compositions, consolidating, and training XGBoost will produce the required evaluation results.

support.quote: To train the XGBoost model, I need to first generate a comprehensive dataset of nitrides polymorphs from the Materials Project. This involves retrieving polymorphs for multiple chemical compositions, selecting them strategically, and consolidating them into a single dataset.

hypothesis.canonical: Retrieving polymorphs for multiple nitride compositions, consolidating, and training XGBoost will produce the required evaluation results.
